scope: Retained two-region dependency model plus already retained Exe dated evidence explicitly selected by its authoritative next-task. Exe is a disconnected bounded temporal branch, not imported as Tryfan or Riffelhorn water evidence.

dimensions.physical: Frozen ClaimTime/TimeExtent with role and source precision. Monthly observation bin is not continuous validity.
dimensions.source: Provider publication/revision versus native survey time; listing last_modified is locator metadata only, not source publication.
dimensions.retention: Actual retained receipt retrieval/subset acquisition, or explicit unknown; no filesystem/commit dates.
dimensions.preparation: Exact method/artifact lineage, actual dated run receipt only if established; unknown otherwise.
dimensions.knowledge: Controlled accepted ordinals K0-K4 plus actual execution UTC receipts, explicitly not historical Atlas-global acquisition. Immutable same-assignment revisions/supersession.
dimensions.publication: Explicit committed generation identity/order; measured run switch receipt external. Never physical chronology.

correction.meaning: Controlled scoped qualification correction only; retained bytes and recorded codes/time unchanged. Not a provider correction or physical event.
correction.exe: March point/support get explicit qualification notice; March count and paired output receipts depend on changed qualification.

querySemantics: Observation/event/survey interval overlap with inclusive v1 date endpoints expanded by declared precision; exact instant seconds retained.

unknown requested-axis time partitions as indeterminate, not success/absence.
